<!--
Most pull requests here are opened by agent-branches.yml from the branch's
commit message, and never see this template. It is for the ones a person
opens by hand.

Keep it to what a reader needs to judge the change. The fleet's own pull
requests answer the same three questions, so this is the shape to match.
-->

## What changed, and why

<!-- The argument, not the diff. The diff is below. -->

## What I checked

<!--
Not "the checks passed" -- CI says that itself. What did you verify that a
machine could not? A citation you opened, a page you rendered and looked at,
a failure you reproduced before fixing.
-->

## What I did not do

<!--
The most useful section, and the one most often left out. What you noticed
and deliberately left alone, what you were unsure about, what this makes
easier later.
-->
